BL-1495 — The b.ai gateway (tencentcloud2/glm-5.3-flash, certified for every pipeline role on 2026-09-08) cannot be seated: pack_staffing_gate_lib.bb's api-base host table has no api.b.ai entry so the launch gate refuses the seat as unresolved, swarmforge.sh's pane-launch provider map has no case for it so an aider pane boots with no OPENAI_API_KEY while B_AI_API_KEY sits unused in the shell, the respawn and scrub paths know nothing of it, and a claude seat on claude-fable-5-1 (certified for specifier the same day) is unresolved too; a b.ai seat resolves, launches, survives a respawn and authenticates, and the glm-mono-router pack the operator asked for ships with it
What it solves: - Minted 2026-09-08 by the specifier from the intake, one ticket rather
  than a launch/respawn split: a seat that authenticates at launch and
  not after a respawn is exactly the dark path BL-1235 warns about, and
  babysitterd respawns roles after every supervisor halt (BL-1490).
  Grepped first:…
